title: Unclosed Code Span
message: I reached the end of the block before finding a closing '`' for the code span.
_note: bd-ilv8p: this diagnostic is currently dormant. The multi-line code-span lift requires a closing backtick to exist within the paragraph before any code span starts, so a bare unclosed '`' is now handled by the generic parse-error path rather than producing the labeled code_span_delimiter token this case relied on. The corpus entry is kept as documentation; restore a `cases` array if a future grammar change exposes a parser state where Q-2-24 fires distinctly.
